correction: Invoice Number Owner Editability — UAT blocker fix
root_cause: In InvoiceCreate.jsx the Invoice Number <input> had `disabled={!((user?.effective_role || user?.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'owner')}`. In the deployed demo session `user.role` did not resolve to the literal 'owner', so the input rendered permanently disabled — blocking Owner override at create time.
fix: Removed the `disabled=` prop. The server already enforces owner-only override (POST /api/invoices requires role='owner' when invoice_number differs from suggested + reason ≥ 10 chars + unique index). Client helper text updated from 'Owner-only override' to 'Non-owner overrides will be rejected on save' so non-owners are still warned that their attempt will fail.
